Membership Pricing and Plan Overview
The current China plans are Go, Plus, Pro, and Max. The tables below describe new plans; see the legacy-plan section for existing subscriptions. Check the membership pricing page for current prices, full benefits, and purchase eligibility.
Monthly and annual pricing
China membership pricing with annual billing, captured on October 12, 2026. The large prices are monthly equivalents; annual totals are billed upfront.
Plan | Monthly billing | Annual total | Monthly equivalent with annual billing
Go | ¥49/month | ¥468/year | ¥39/month
Plus | ¥99/month | ¥948/year | ¥79/month
Pro | ¥199/month | ¥1,908/year | ¥159/month
Max | ¥699/month | ¥6,708/year | ¥559/month
Annual billing is charged as one annual total. The monthly equivalent is for comparison and is not billed monthly. Save up to ¥1,680/year with annual billing.
